defects.note: COMMIT after the inner labelled loop's END LOOP but still inside the outer labelled loop; a final COMMIT after the outer loop is fine
comments and a string containing 'END LOOP;' precede a COMMIT written after a block comment on the same line
ROLLBACK in an ELSIF branch after a nested IF ... END IF, with CONTINUE WHEN and EXIT WHEN in the loop
COMMIT WORK split over two lines (marker on the COMMIT line), in a loop that follows a nested subprogram whose own COMMIT is outside any loop
COMMIT in an $IF branch inside the loop (both conditional-compilation branches are analysed)

negatives.note: COMMIT/ROLLBACK only in comments, a string and an identifier containing 'commit' inside the loop; a quoted identifier "COMMIT" is a column; the real COMMIT follows the loop
COMMIT inside an IF before the loop and after it; the loop body holds a CASE statement and EXIT WHEN
loop only calls a nested procedure that commits; the COMMIT is not lexically inside any loop
ROLLBACK TO written over two lines and with/without SAVEPOINT keyword inside a loop handler; plain ROLLBACK only after the loop
ROLLBACK in the handler of a block that ENCLOSES the loop (handler is outside the loop); COMMIT follows that block
